form_title: 2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)

reports.notes: Handwritten. The candidate's name is written 'TRACY' on the form (index/portal filename also says Tracy); no disagreement. Street address and City cells were left blank/redacted on the cover - only State 'Ut.' and Zip '84604' are written, so residence_city is ''. Lines 3 and 7 are a slashed-zero glyph (the filer's zero), transcribed as 0 at medium confidence. Cents on lines 1-6 are written as superscripts over the decimal ('135.' with a raised '00'); transcribed as full decimals. Line 1 Column B is written without a thousands comma (4709.30) while line 2 Column B has one (4,709.30) - both kept verbatim as printed. office_index said 'County Sheriff'; the page says 'SHERIFF' (a naming-convention difference, not a conflict). candidate_index was blank; the page names JAMES O. TRACY JR.

contributions.note: THE CANDIDATE'S OWN LOAN, booked by the filer onto the CONTRIBUTIONS ledger and confirmed as a contribution by the document's own arithmetic (Schedule A subtotal 135.00 = printed total 135.00 = cover Column A line 1 135.00, with line 3 Balance at Beginning a slashed zero) — the opposite outcome from the Witney 2010 loan, where the cover assigned the loan to the beginning balance. '(LOAN TO SELF)' is the filer's own parenthetical, hand-written ABOVE the name on the same ruled line, and is carried verbatim inside donor_raw rather than being dropped or split into a second row. Cents are written as a RAISED '00' over the decimal. ADDRESS CELL: the filer DID write a mailing address, but the reproduction lost it — at 900 and 1200 dpi only the ascender tips survive above the printed rule and no word is readable, so donor_city and donor_state are honestly BLANK. This is neither an empty cell nor a county redaction (this file carries no redaction bars and the Schedule B address cell on p4 reproduces cleanly); it is a legibility loss on this page only. PRIVACY: nothing from the address cell is carried in any case.

expenditures.note: SCHEDULE B ON THIS 2010 BLANK PRINTS NO PURPOSE COLUMN — its four column headers are copied from Schedule A and read 'Date / Name of Contributor / Mailing Address & Zip Code / Amount'. The filer supplied the purpose anyway, hand-writing it as a second line ABOVE the vendor name inside the same Name cell; the upper line is transcribed as `purpose` and the lower line as `vendor_raw`, and the assignment is the filer's own layout, not an inference. The purpose line is written with quotation marks around THANK YOU AD, kept verbatim; the spacing in 'POST ELECTION' is tight on the page and could equally be read as one word. Vendor is written 'NEWS PAPER' as two words by the filer and kept verbatim. Cents are a raised '00'. The vendor's street address is printed legibly on the form and is deliberately NOT carried — expenditure rows hold no address field at all.

itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-19 wave B2 utah, chunk r2_02b)

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($135.00) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($135.00) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' ($135.00)
contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row sums to 135.00 = the schedule's own printed page subtotal (135.00) = the schedule's printed Total Contributions Received (135.00) = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell, Column A line 1 (135.00). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 4,709.30 and is NOT summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime): it carries the whole 2010 cycle, which this final 30-days-after-the-General report does not itemize. THE SUM ALSO DECIDES THE LOAN QUESTION (Addendum A4, Witney precedent): the one entry is the candidate's own '(LOAN TO SELF)', and unlike Witney's the arithmetic here books it AS A CONTRIBUTION, not as a beginning balance — line 3 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' is a SLASHED ZERO, line 4 (from line 1 Column A) is 135.00, line 5 subtotal is 135.00, line 6 (from line 2 Column A) is 135.00 and line 7 'Balance at Close' is a slashed zero, so the ladder is 0 + 135.00 - 135.00 = 0 and reads the 135.00 through the CONTRIBUTION line. Treating it as a beginning balance instead would have left Schedule A summing to 0.00 against a printed 135.00. The row is therefore published as an itemized contribution, with the filer's own loan annotation preserved verbatim.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($135.00) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (135.00) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' (135.00)
expenditures.detail: The single Schedule B row sums to 135.00 = the printed page subtotal (135.00) = the printed Total Expenditures Received (135.00) = the cover's promoted per-period Column A line 2 (135.00), and it is echoed at line 6 of the balance ladder (135.00). Column B YTD expenditures print 4,709.30 and are never summed as an increment. Contributions and expenditures happen to carry the identical figure this period (135.00 / 135.00) and the identical cumulative figure (4,709.30 / 4,709.30) — that is the document's own arithmetic, a campaign that spent every dollar it took in, and no cross-side inference was drawn from the coincidence.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and it is untestable-by-difference here because the two conventions coincide: neither schedule prints an in-kind column, the cover prints no in-kind line, and no row is marked in-kind, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind both sum to 135.00 on each side and both close exactly on Column A. BOTH were tested per the brief; neither was inherited as a family default.
itemized.escalation_note: Three escalations, all for legibility, none for truth. (1) The A1 FIRST-ENTRY CONTROL on p3: make_snippet --dpi 900 on the EXTRAPOLATED band 1 (pct:83.04,15.96,10.06,4.05@p3) rendered the printed column headers 'Date / Name of Contributor / Mailing Address & Zip Code / Amount' over the written line '11-04-10 | JAMES O. TRACY JR (LOAN TO SELF) | <address ghost> | $135.00' — so on this filing the first written entry IS band 1, unlike the Houskeeper 2010 case. (2) The same control on p4 (pct:83.65,15.74,10.12,4.06@p4) rendered '11-04-10 | PAID "THANK YOU AD" POST ELECTION / DAILY HERALD NEWS PAPER | ... | $135.00'. (3) THE p3 ADDRESS CELL, escalated twice — --dpi 900 on the full row strip and then --value tight crops at --dpi 1200 over pct:53.5,16.4,14,4.0@p3 and pct:66,16.4,15,4.0@p3. Both rendered ONLY THE ASCENDER TIPS of a line of handwriting sitting on the printed rule: the lower two-thirds of every glyph is swallowed by the rule and by the reproduction, leaving a broken row of disconnected marks with no readable word. The cell is NOT blank and it is NOT redacted by the county (there is no bar; this 2010 file is not a *_Redacted.pdf and Schedule B's address cell on the very next page reproduces perfectly). It is a reproduction loss, so donor_city / donor_state are honestly BLANK and the amount, which is unaffected and closes exactly, is untouched.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'JAMES O. TRACY JR.' — index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 county_static listing grouped filings by office), so the page face governs and is offered to the coordinator for promotion into that EMPTY channel cell. Office Seeking hand-written 'SHERIFF' (the index/channel office is 'County Sheriff'; the page prints the bare word, which is the same office, not a disagreement). Party printed 'REPUBLICAN'. legacy_colAB variant, 4 pages, each classified from its OWN printed header: p1 COVER ('2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed 'SUMMARY PAGE' header, at the expected p2 ordinal for this variant), p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. Report type: '30 Days after the General Election', marked with an X. Amendment: 'No' is ticked (an explicit answer, unlike the Campbell filing in this same chunk). Signed and dated by the candidate 'Nov. 9TH 2010'; clerk stamp 'NOV 9 AM10:46' — filer date and receipt date agree. FOLIATION: this filer DID complete the page header box, writing 'Page 1 of 1' on pages 2, 3 and 4 alike, with last name 'TRACY' and Date of Report 'Nov. 9th, 2010' on p2 and '11-09-10' on p3/p4 — i.e. each sheet is numbered '1 of 1' independently rather than 1/2/3 of 3, which is a third foliation convention beyond the two Addendum A4 records for Poulson, and another reason a page ordinal never locates the summary page. RESIDENCE: the cover's Street Address and City cells are LEFT EMPTY BY THE FILER (not redacted) — only 'Ut.' and the zip are written — so no residence city is carried. BOTH SIDES CLOSE EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A. The single most notable property of this filing is the SELF-LOAN on the contribution ledger, resolved by arithmetic rather than by category (see the contributions recon detail).
